verdict: PASS for the actual stated universality theorem and strict-count corollaries

checks.compressed_resolvent_to_fractional_power: PASS: uniform compressed first moment supplies an integrable dimension-independent majorant
checks.growing_fast_subspace: PASS: all operator norm constants are independent of its dimension
checks.generalized_ritz: PASS: the test subspace is exactly physical-constant-orthogonal and the correct fractional pair is compressed
checks.inverse_fractional_powers: PASS: no growing-dimensional inverse-power convergence is used
checks.logdet_exhaustion: PASS: all leading deficits and the total logarithmic tail are nonnegative and sum to zero in the limit
checks.simple_unweighted_bipartite: PASS: disjoint gadget interiors and parity choices preserve the required graph class
checks.exact_resistance: PASS: all other components dangle from single ports; the three length-three paths have resistance one
checks.quantifiers: PASS: matrix scale, grounding mass, rational approximation and cell-size limits are sequential
checks.strict_threshold: PASS: exact product budget gives strict inequality and ceiling-minus-one count

scope_note: The source proves universality for every finite target of product 2^alpha. A claim that these are the only padded-supremum limits across unrestricted growing dimensions would be false: the finite-target closure in that topology permits product <= 2^alpha. Equality is recovered when the logarithmic budget of the extra spectrum must vanish.
